# crosswork_login_banner (Data Source)

This data source can read the pre-login disclaimer of the cluster.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "crosswork_login_banner" "example" {
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `instance` (String) Select an instance of the provider configuration by its name. Leave it unset to use the default instance.

### Read-Only

- `icon` (String) Icon of the disclaimer
- `id` (String) The id of the object
- `message` (String) Text of the disclaimer
- `show_message` (Boolean) Show the disclaimer before the login
- `title` (String) Title of the disclaimer
- `user_ack` (Boolean) Ask the user to acknowledge the disclaimer. The controller reads it as false whenever `show_message` is false
